title: All-fixed-count satellite transverse half bound
statement: In the majority-plus-k-satellite family of Iteration 5, fix k>=2 before sending the majority size to infinity. On the zero-sum satellite-transverse sector, the half-prefix limiting coefficient h_k is at least 1/2 for every effective coupling eta in [0,1]; the relaxation multiplier is at least one, so the full reduced ratio is also at least 1/2.
assumptions: Satellite count k is fixed before the majority-size limit
The tested direction has zero sum on the satellite coordinates
The effective fixed-k reduction described in the source applies
open_objections: The other invariant sector, growing k, and finite nonorthogonal matrices are not covered.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
